disambiguation: Hindsight is a synchronization and AI querying tool, ensuring the vault remains the canonical source of truth and is not replaced by the external memory bank.
extras: Supports self-hosting via CLI; sync is one-way (Obsidian -> Hindsight).
problem: Users need a way to query and interact with the knowledge contained within their local Obsidian vault using AI while maintaining the vault as the single source of truth.
summary: Hindsight sync's Obsidian notes to an external memory bank and provides an AI chat panel that answers questions grounded in the vault content and cites sources.
